uncited: **Work Distribution:** Group rays from an image-tile (a square image having a certain size) to improve ray-coherency in a ray group.
Each thread retrieves the intersection list for its assigned pixel from the flat array.
* **Image Tile Size:** Determines the block size for thread grouping.
It extends prior image-tile-based work distribution methods to fit modern GPU architectures.
It addresses limitations in previous GPU-based approaches, such as the inefficiency of per-thread local buffers and the inaccuracy of cell projection methods for non-convex geometries.
